## Supervisor v0.8.1

### Emailing several students at once
- **Tick students:** every student list now has a tick box in front of each name. The box at the top of the list ticks everyone shown.
- **Copy emails:** click **Copy emails** above the list, then paste into the **To** field of a new message in Outlook or Gmail. The emails are separated by semicolons, which both accept.
- **With a search:** only the students shown are copied, so you can search first (for example by course) and then tick everyone shown.
- **Missing emails:** if a ticked student has no email in Supervisor, a message at the bottom of the window says who, so you can add it.
- **Unticking:** **Untick all** clears the ticks. Moving to another list also clears them.

### Notes
- Existing data files open unchanged.
